author: Forbes
description:
Steven Bartlett — founder and host of The Diary of a CEO — explains why success isn’t about avoiding failure, but accelerating it.

The real advantage comes from how quickly you can test, learn and adapt. Every failure teaches you something — and over time, that learning compounds into an edge.
title: Why Failure Is the Fastest Way to Win

author: Forbes
description:
The 2026 Subaru Outback arrives as a calculated response to five years of intensive consumer research, navigating a delicate balance between its heritage as an adventurous wagon and a strategic pivot toward an SUV-centric shape. Completely redesigned for the 2026 model year, the Outback introduces a more chiseled silhouette and a simplified lineup that removes the traditional base model in favor of a standard "Premium" entry point starting at approximately $35,000.

While the core BOXER engine remains the heartbeat of the vehicle—offering 260 horsepower in the turbo configuration—the real transformation is found in the reinforced architecture. The roof is now designed to accommodate a rooftop tent, while the side rails can independently support up to 220 pounds for accessories like hammocks or sunvisors.
